notes: The authors label this initial. The preceding commit removed the existing project tree, leaving an empty parent; this commit then added a new project tree. We classify the purge followed by an upload as re-import.

The authors label this initial because it is an early bulk upload. We classify the depth outlier as resource: crypto-config files reach depth 14, while files outside crypto-config reach only depth 11. Without crypto-config, the increase would be 10, below the threshold of 12.

The authors label this tests. We classify the commit as initial because it transfers the project from SVN after a parent containing only README.md and .gitignore. Both src/test and src/main contain files at the maximum depth of 13; committed .svn metadata contributes the final two levels, so the test tree is not the only source of that depth.
